summary: Implemented the endpoint resolver v2 builtin-parameter glue as an unused method, ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults, in botocore/args.py. It returns AWS::Region, AWS::UseFIPS, AWS::UseDualStack, SDK::Endpoint, AWS::S3::Accelerate, AWS::S3::ForcePathStyle and AWS::S3::UseArnRegion, with defaults matching existing S3 handling. Added TestEndpointResolverBuiltinDefaults (5 tests) to tests/unit/test_args.py. tests/unit/test_args.py passes (42 tests). Running test_client.py, test_session.py and test_args.py together gave 383 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed; the failing test_session.py::TestSessionComponent::test_internal_component also fails with my changes stashed, so it is pre-existing. Nothing is committed. Open choices: the STS/S3Control global-endpoint and account-id builtins were left out since the spec does not list them, and the method is not wired into client creation, per the spec's unused-code scope.
